model: Unchanged original Nano detector, fixed four views and postprocessing from the Nano candidate
selection: At an observed host checkpoint, select the latest released image, stopping at the first released missing/failed event. A due non-image event takes priority over its preceding queued images. Never cross a non-image event or select a future acquisition.
discarded_images: Record every superseded source and its original acquisition and hash; perform no inference, guard delivery or recovery update for it.
timing: Original acquisition timestamps and two-second schedule bound. Preserve the exact original per-frame measured controller, 0.2 second age bound, two-sample recovery and fault epochs.
denominators: Keep all original source images in coverage counts; count dispatch deadlines separately. A superseded source is neither inferred nor an available result.
fault_latency: This synchronous offline replay cannot preempt active inference. Missing/failed events are delivered when the single consumer next dispatches; this is not live fault supervision.
